question: is Aut(MASA) = measure-preserving (permutation) or diffeomorphism?
answer: Aut(MASA) = permutation group S_N (monomial, DISCRETE measure-preserving), NOT Diff(M) (continuous group). Rotation (finite-dim slice of Diff) is NOT an automorphism of D_N.
conclusion: P1 first half (noncommutative -> commutative = E) REACHABLE; P1 second half = P3 (commutative MASA = measure -> manifold = diffeomorphism) NOT reachable. Measure (permutation, discrete) != differential structure (Diff, continuous).
